generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: an invasive bramble of thick, arching, thorny canes that root at the tips and build impenetrable mounds, with leaves of five toothed leaflets and pale pink flowers. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 2.3 m tall at 12 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: dark green leaflets, pale beneath; pale pink flowers; red-purple canes. Fruit (plant roadmap P4), as in mid-July: panicles of berries, most still green or red, the first black. Its year (appearance.organs.bloom.season) is authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands: white to pink flowers in June and July; berries green, red, then black from August into October. The forest's packages show day 196 (mid-July) until the phenology of plant roadmap P5 sets the day from the date and the local climate.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

generator.program.note: The program the spec's authors chose to grow this form.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy from the step-6 catalogue, authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands. Calibration against measurements and photographs is milestone P4.
